answers.confirmed: the coprime hierarchy is a statement about WHICH CHANNEL IS RESONANT, not about stability, in either model
answers.corrected: the successor question guessed MIRROR-IMAGE obstruction loci. The loci COINCIDE: the relabelling acts on monomials, not on (p, q), so the set of ratios admitting an obstruction is literally the same. It is the CHANNEL that mirrors.
answers.question: GHOST_MODEL_OBSTRUCTION

does_not_establish: that the ghost model is unstable -- only that the charge argument bounding the healthy model has no counterpart here; an unbounded level set permits growth without producing it
that the ghost model's cubic vertex actually contains the pair-creation monomial with nonzero coefficient, which is a computation in the deformation rather than a statement about the resonant sector
that no conserved quantity of HIGHER degree bounds the ghost model; only diagonal quadratic charges al n1 + be n2 are considered

the bracket action on monomials, which is the DEFINITION ghost_freq here as it is in the predecessor, certified in Forge as a polynomial identity rather than derived from the implementation inside Rocq
anything about Weyl gravity, the BV-BFV complex, or the residual classes -- the Weyl ghost is a genuinely indefinite system, which is why the question was asked, but this is a two-mode toy
gate_negative_controls: a FALSE claim that the conversion kernel is resonant in the ghost model is REJECTED — without it the two models would obstruct through the same channel and the separation would be vacuous
a FALSE claim that the surviving ghost charge can be positive is REJECTED — without it the sign of h0 would be doing no work, which is the entire content of the module

ledger.declared_assumptions_in_source: none — no Axiom, Parameter, Hypothesis, Conjecture, Admitted or admit
ledger.print_assumptions_closed: 17/17 in GhostModelObstruction.v; 234/234 across the twenty-three modules the shared gate drives
ledger.rationals_not_reals: the unboundedness argument is over Q. Coq's R is axiomatised, and importing it would put axioms in the ledger for a statement that does not need them.

record_kind: PROVENANCE_IMPORT — the mathematics is in rocq/GhostModelObstruction.v; this file computes nothing

the_separation.mathematics: the obstruction — a statement about a critical degree p+q and a coprimality condition, identical in both models
the_separation.physics: the boundedness — a consequence of the free Hamiltonian being positive-definite, and absent as soon as it is not
the_separation.why_it_matters: conflating the two produced the original wrong gloss. The predecessor showed the obstruction does not destabilise; this shows the thing that bounds is not the obstruction either.

theorems.name: ghost_resonant_iff_resonant_of_conj2
theorems.role: THE MIRROR. Everything else follows by transporting the healthy model's classification across this bijection.
theorems.statement: a monomial is resonant for h0 = p n1 - q n2 exactly when its a2 <-> a2b relabelling is resonant for h0 = p n1 + q n2

theorems.name: conj2_kernel_is_pair_creation
theorems.role: the single fact the successor question was built on, now proved rather than conjectured
theorems.statement: the relabelling carries the conversion kernel a1^q a2b^p to pair creation a1^q a2^p

theorems.name: kernel_is_not_ghost_resonant
theorems.role: the channels genuinely differ; without this the two models would obstruct identically and the separation would be vacuous
theorems.statement: the healthy model's obstructing monomial is NOT resonant in the ghost model

theorems.name: ghost_resonant_at_critical_degree
theorems.role: the classification transports with IDENTICAL hypotheses -- same positivity, same coprimality, same critical degree. Only the two named monomials change.
theorems.statement: a nonnegative ghost-resonant monomial at total degree p+q is diagonal, pair creation, or pair annihilation

theorems.name: obstruction_ratios_are_unchanged
theorems.role: CORRECTS the successor question. The loci do not mirror -- they coincide, because the involution acts on monomials and not on (p, q).
theorems.statement: the ghost and healthy critical sectors are in degree- and nonnegativity-preserving bijection at every (p, q)

theorems.name: surviving_ghost_charge_is_indefinite
theorems.role: WHERE THE MODELS PART. The only diagonal quadratic charge surviving in the ghost model is indefinite.
theorems.statement: q*al + p*be = 0 with p, q > 0 forces al*be < 0 unless the charge is trivial

theorems.name: healthy_charge_is_not_conserved_on_pair_creation
theorems.role: the contrast made exact, and a non-vacuity check on the previous line
theorems.statement: the positive charge (p, q) is NOT conserved on pair creation

theorems.name: ghost_model_charge_does_not_bound_occupations
theorems.role: an unbounded level set. Note the boundary: this PERMITS growth, it does not produce it.
theorems.statement: for any bound B there is a physical state on the surviving charge's level set with n1 > B

theorems.name: healthy_model_charge_does_bound_occupations
theorems.role: restated in the ghost module so the dichotomy is readable in one place: same p, same q, same nonnegativity, only the sign of h0 differs
theorems.statement: the same conservation law with the opposite sign bounds both occupations
